name: File Lock
description: Cooperative locking for concurrent agents in a shared worktree. Edit and Write get a sibling .locked file before they change a file. The plugin breaks a stale lock automatically (dead PID or a time threshold). The LockStatus tool examines the locks under the cwd, and the plugin gives a CLI for human use. To disable it, set `plugins["file-lock"].enabled = false` in `~/.minimal-agent/config.jsonc`, or set the env var `MINIMAL_AGENT_FILE_LOCK_DISABLED=1`.

tool.name: LockStatus
tool.description: Inspect or clear the cooperative file locks under the working directory. Use it when an Edit or Write call fails on a locked file. Use it when you must know which peer agent holds a file. Do not use it to change file content. Use Edit or Write for a content change. For an action of list, it gives the lock list with the holder session, pid, host and age. It gives one holder record for inspect, and a removed count for clear-stale.

action.description: Operation to run. The list action reads the directory and shows each lock with its holder details. The inspect action shows the metadata of one lock. The clear-stale action removes the locks whose holder pid is dead or older than 5 minutes. The clear action removes one named lock and is unsafe on a live peer.

path.description: For `list`/`clear-stale`: the directory to walk (default: cwd). For `inspect`/`clear`: absolute path of the locked file, not the .locked sibling.

format.description: Output format. `text` (default) is compact ANSI for transcript reading. `json` is parseable for programmatic use.
